claim: The sample opens in one click and does not save data.
where: landing first screen, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed an unrelated localStorage value; use sample controls; assert the value is unchanged and no demo data is stored

claim: The sample and extension package are available without an account.
sandbox: fresh browser context with no cookies or credentials; open the sample and fetch the extension package successfully

claim: Selected page text is not transmitted or written into saved rules.
where: landing facts and privacy answer, privacy page, README, popup
sandbox: packaged MV3 extension on a local fixture; record every HTTP request and payload; inspect the exact saved-rule fields after selection, reflow, save, and reopen

claim: Every reading feature works without a license, and unavailable checkout is not linked.
where: landing first screen and supporter section, privacy page, terms, README, popup
sandbox: fresh extension profile with no license; assert no checkout link and exercise selection, settings, navigation, save, and reopen

claim: Alt+Shift+R starts selection and a pointer click opens the chosen region.
sandbox: packaged MV3 extension; assert the registered shortcut, invoke its selection message, click a region, and assert the reading pane opens

claim: A region can be previewed, selected, and opened with the keyboard.
sandbox: desktop and 390 px packaged-extension contexts; invoke selection, use Tab/Arrow and Enter/Space, and assert focus moves into the pane

claim: Escape cancels region selection without opening the reading pane.
sandbox: desktop and 390 px packaged-extension contexts; start selection, press Escape, and assert the selection help and pane are closed

claim: On desktop, the reading pane keeps nearby page controls visible.
where: landing first screen and product explanation, README
sandbox: desktop packaged extension; open the pane and assert a source-page control remains entirely visible beside it

claim: Escape closes the reading pane and returns focus.
where: landing proof strip and workflow, README
sandbox: packaged MV3 extension; focus a source-page link, open the pane, press Escape, and assert the pane closes and focus returns

claim: The reading pane preserves headings, lists, links, form labels, and image text alternatives.
sandbox: packaged MV3 extension; select a fixture containing each named semantic and assert its role, level, association, target, or text alternative in the pane

claim: Live region updates flow into the reading pane.
sandbox: packaged MV3 extension; mutate the selected source after opening and assert the new sentence appears after the debounce

claim: J, K, Up, and Down move through sentences and announce the current position.
sandbox: packaged MV3 extension; use all four keys, assert forward and backward positions, lower-bound behavior, and the live announcement

claim: The pane provides 20–28 px type and 42–70 character line presets in light and dark.
where: landing proof strip and workflow, README
sandbox: packaged MV3 extension; set both extremes and both themes, save, and inspect applied CSS and stored values

claim: A saved site rule reopens with its latest reading settings.
sandbox: packaged MV3 extension; save dark/28/70, change to light/20/42, reload, and assert the latest settings reopen

claim: A saved site rule can be removed from the extension popup.
sandbox: packaged MV3 extension with one saved rule; remove it from the popup and assert extension storage contains no rules

claim: The reading pane fills the 390 px viewport at narrow widths.
sandbox: 390 px packaged-extension context; open a region and assert the fixed pane starts at x=0 and is exactly 390 CSS px wide

claim: The extension runs on ordinary websites and does not run on browser-internal pages.
sandbox: fresh extension profile; assert the manifest is limited to HTTP(S), the content script loads on local HTTP, and a message to about:blank is rejected

claim: The Chrome download is a valid extension ZIP.
sandbox: fresh site context; fetch the linked artifact and assert an HTTP success, exact non-redirected package URL, and ZIP magic bytes

claim: Normal website use loads only first-party resources, sets no cookies, and stores only the chosen theme.
sandbox: fresh browser context; record all normal home-page requests, cookies, and localStorage after a theme change

claim: A returned supporter license is stored locally, removed from the URL, and verified with Sociobot.
where: landing supporter section, privacy page, terms
sandbox: fresh site context with a returned token and recorded license endpoint; assert local storage, URL stripping, one verification request, and active status

claim: A previously valid supporter status remains identified when a refresh cannot reach the license service.
sandbox: seed a stale valid cached verdict, abort the license request, and assert the offline status while free actions remain available

claim: The product page reloads offline after the first controlled visit.
sandbox: dedicated browser context; wait for service-worker control, update, go offline, reload, and assert the home heading renders

claim: A cached supporter-license verdict is reused for less than one day.
sandbox: fixed timestamps immediately before and exactly at the 24-hour boundary
